_seed_doc: Golden seed corpus: CONVERSION/DE-ESCALATION archetype. Enemy raiders may surrender; tests agent_id stability across enemy->NPC conversion, healing on NPCs, and NPC dialogue mechanics. Cloned from session_config_npc_deescalation_test.json (duplicate Charm skill key cleaned up).

initial_enemies.name: Freeborn Raiders
initial_enemies.spawn_reason: Cornered smugglers caught in contraband operation

initial_npcs.name: Dock Worker Kassia
initial_npcs.description: Terrified civilian dock worker hiding behind cargo crates, caught in crossfire between raiders and enforcers

players.name: Negotiator Wei Lin
goals: Resolve conflicts through diplomacy when possible

scenario.situation: You've cornered a group of Freeborn raiders who were smuggling contraband. They're outgunned but not yet defeated. They might surrender if given the chance - or fight desperately if they feel trapped with no options. A civilian dock worker is hiding nearby, terrified of the crossfire.

scenario_hint: DM should spawn NPCs based on player actions: de-escalated enemies become wary/prisoner NPCs, the civilian can be convinced to help or may flee, wounded enemies can be stabilized via healing. Prisoners can provide intel via dialogue. If players attack surrendered NPCs, they should escalate back to enemies.
notes: GOLDEN SEED: Conversion/de-escalation archetype - enemy->NPC lifecycle with agent_id stability.
